name: SH-4: only firing indicators contradict the diagnosis → contradiction, never support

expected.explanation: Inconclusive: the evidence does not affirmatively resolve to clean or to any threat.

why: M09: the only observations in the run actively contradict dnsSpoofing's support rules. Contradictory observations add contradiction mass and must never enter supportingIndicators / alignedSupport / hasDecisive, must never count as support for the diagnosis, and must never flip the run to an affirmative clean. Because they contribute no observed support, nothing reaches the overhang floor: the run is plain inconclusive.
